alex: Quick head's up — I ran a quick cross-region bench comparing Llama-2-70B, Mistral-7B-v0.2, and Qwen-14B on a100/h100/mi300 with 2k and 32k contexts. Measuring p50/p95 token latency, and throughput at batch sizes 1/4/8. Posting raw here, need help triaging kernel fallbacks for GQA/rope and sizing the Dedicated pools.

perf-bot: Automated run completed: s3://redwood-bench/2128881234/results.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend: Summaries below.

perf-bot: ```
Model,GPU,ctx,Batch,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens/s
llama-2-70b,a100,2048,1,18.2,54.1,150
mistral-7b,h100,2048,1,12.8,38.6,220
qwen-14b,mi300,2048,1,25.4,120.2,95
llama-2-70b,a100,32768,1,145.0,420.3,12
qwen-14b,mi300,32768,1,320.1,1300.5,3
```

maya: Whoa Qwen on mi300 is a massive p95 blowup for 32k — looks like GQA fallback? @chen any kernel logs?

chen: I saw warnings in the runtime: `gqa_fallback: true` on mi300 for qwen when seq_len > 16384. Attaching a tiny snippet from the node logs.

chen: ```
[2026-03-19 12:03:55] kernel_select: selected=mi_gemm_fallback, reason=unsupported_gqa_pattern
[2026-03-19 12:03:55] kv_cache: split_shard=true, split_axis=0
```

sanjay: Weird — Llama and Mistral scale much better at long ctx. Qwen's pos-enc/GQA interaction seems to trip a non-vectorized path on MI. My hypothesis: our GQA pattern matcher misses tiled layout for Qwen's rotary offsets, causing fallback to scalar kernel. Repro command: `bench --model qwen --gpu mi300 --ctx 32768 --batch 1 --trace-kernel`

eva: I'll kick off the trace now and capture `nsys`/nvtx. Also going to run quant4a vs quant4m: last time quant reduced memory but increased compute for qwen, so want to verify.

maya: Also noticed throughput drop on mi300 at batch=4 — for capacity sizing that implies mi300 needs more reserved slots for longctx Qwen. Rough starting estimate: 1 mi300 per ~4 concurrent longctx qwen clients to keep p95 < 500ms (very rough).

alex: Plan: chen to bisect kernel matcher for GQA shape -> make a minimal reproducer and open GH issue; eva to upload nsys traces and run quant experiments; sanjay to update capacity calc in the sizing sheet. I'll open a GH issue and link results + suggested temporary mitigations.

perf-bot: Summary: 
• Median ordering (short ctx): Mistral < Llama < Qwen.
• Long ctx (32k): Qwen@mi300 p95 >> others due to kernel fallback to mi_gemm_fallback.
• Throughput: Mistral highest tokens/s for 2k; Llama wins for stable longctx; Qwen suffers on MI at long ctx.
• Temporary mitigations: route longctx Qwen requests to h100/a100 variants, enable aggressive prefix/KV caching, reduce batch size, or force quantized variant if quality allows.

alex: Assigning: @chen GH issue (please include minimal reproducer) and tag `infra/kernel-gqa`; @eva upload traces to s3://redwood-bench/2128881234/nsys/ and include a short nsys summary; @sanjay update the dedicated capacity calc in the sheet and propose a conservative commit. Ping me tomorrow for a possible rollback window if we plan routing changes.

maya: LGTM :thumbsup:
